summary: Verified the two new frontend features on the preview URL. (1) FAQ nav link is visible in desktop top nav (data-testid=nav-link-faq) and mobile menu (data-testid=nav-mobile-link-faq); both navigate to /faq which renders data-testid=faq-page with h1 'Everything sales leaders ask us.' and 6 categorized sections. (2) /travel-incentives-vs-discounting renders data-testid=comparison-page with h1 'Travel incentives vs. discounting.', all 7 comparison rows (compare-row-0..6), FAQ section (compare-faq-0..2), and the CTA button (comparison-cta) correctly links to and navigates to /contact. Footer link 'Incentives vs. Discounting' is present and navigates correctly. Regression: all existing nav pages (Home, Programs, Industries, Case Studies, Resources, About, plus new FAQ) load without blank pages. /contact renders Calendly embed referencing calendly.com/bestbuyincentives5/30min. Zero console errors and zero uncaught page errors during the full flow. Web3Forms form submission was NOT tested per request (domain-restricted, expected to fail on preview).
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx: NavLink data-testid pattern `nav-link-${l.to.replace('/', '')}` is fine for single-segment routes (nav-link-faq, nav-link-programs) and for case-studies (only leading slash removed). It would break for any nested route (e.g., '/foo/bar' -> 'nav-linkfoobar'). Not a defect today, but worth normalizing to slugify if future nested nav items are added.
Comparison.jsx and FAQ.jsx correctly use Seo helper with faqSchema and breadcrumbSchema for AEO/GEO — good.

Footer.jsx footer link to /travel-incentives-vs-discounting has no data-testid. Consider adding data-testid='footer-link-comparison' for easier automated regression testing (current test relied on href selector).
Header darkHeroPages list now includes '/faq' and '/travel-incentives-vs-discounting' — hero transparency behavior is consistent with other dark-hero pages.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (30/30 assertions passed across FAQ nav, mobile menu, comparison page rows/faqs/CTA, footer link, regression nav, Calendly embed presence)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features work end-to-end on preview URL https://bestbuy-incentives.preview.emergentagent.com. Reliable selectors: [data-testid=nav-link-faq], [data-testid=nav-mobile-link-faq], [data-testid=faq-page], [data-testid=comparison-page], [data-testid=compare-row-0..6], [data-testid=compare-faq-0..2], [data-testid=comparison-cta]. Footer comparison link has no data-testid; use footer selector `footer a[href='/travel-incentives-vs-discounting']`. Web3Forms CORS/domain-allowlist issue from iteration_3 is unchanged and is expected on preview (do not retest until dashboard allowlist is fixed).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no issues found in this iteration.
